title: WPSS/1559/2014 of Smt Rita Sharma Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No1559 of 2014
Honíble Rajiv Sharma, J.
None is present for the petitioner.
Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, Brief Holder for the
State.
The petitioner participated in the
selection process for the post of Assistant
Teacher. The petitioner has submitted an
application on 17.02.2014. The candidature
of the petitioner was rejected purportedly on
the ground that she was overage as per the
Recruitment and Promotional Rules modified
in the year 2013, whereby the maximum age
prescribed was 40 years. The petitioner has
admittedly attained the age of 43 years at the
time of submission of application on
17.02.2014.
It is submitted at Bar that there is a
Government order whereby candidates who
have become overage due to delay in
advertisement for the post can submit an
application for relaxation of age criterion.
Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed
of. The petitioner is directed to move an
application seeking relaxation in the upper
age limit within a period of four weeks from
today. The same shall be considered by the
Competent Authority within six weeks after
its receipt and do the needful.
